verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a keyless public JSON endpoint for Colorado's business-entities dataset, and data.colorado.gov advertises analysis of business entities, DBAs, and UCC filing information. This gives read-only programmatic access to registry data. It is served from the Socrata open-data portal rather than the registry itself, and nothing shows API-driven filing, name reservation, periodic reports, or account actions. missing for 10: documented API reference for the registry, write/transactional endpoints for filings and renewals, authentication and developer documentation, independent corroboration of agent-driven use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
